meta_description:
worldbank on February 23, 2026: "Follow us at @worldbankgroup! We’re changing our name on this page from 𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗹𝗱 𝗕𝗮𝗻𝗸 to 𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗹𝗱 𝗕𝗮𝗻𝗸 𝗚𝗿𝗼𝘂𝗽, and here’s why: The people we work with don’t experience us as separate institutions — to them, we’re one team that brings together all parts of the World Bank Group to help countries tackle big challenges. 

That’s exactly how we’re working today: more coordinated, more responsive, and more focused on real results for real people. This small name change reflects that reality. The World Bank Group is our whole family of institutions working together with one mission: to end extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet.".
